issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement UML declares getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (problem_statement.md), and the template's TODO asks to implement it as specified by the UML (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, TODO at line 12). The solution implementation defines public StudentCount getTotalNumberOfStudents() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) and introduces a StudentCount class (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StudentCount.java). This divergence (int vs StudentCount) changes the method's return type and requires an extra type that students do not see in the UML or template, which will confuse students and may make tests or instructor expectations inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Option A (simpler for students): change the solution to return a primitive int from getTotalNumberOfStudents() (remove or stop relying on the StudentCount wrapper) and update any code calling getTotalNumberOfStudents() accordingly. Option B (use an abstraction): update the problem statement UML and template to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): StudentCount and add a brief description of StudentCount to the exercise, and include a StudentCount stub in the template so students see and can use the type. In both cases update the tests and documentation to match the chosen design.
